# What Are the Major Hotel Chains in India?

Published: **May 18, 2023**

Read time: **4 mins**

Last Update: **May 11, 2026**

UGC-Approved

![](https://aaft.edu.in/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Faaft.edu.in%2Fbackend%2Fstatic%2FcmsImages%2Fuploads%2F2023%2F05%2FHospitality-02.jpg&w=3840&q=70)

## Table of Contents

- [Major Hotel Chains in India](https://aaft.edu.in/blog/major-hotel-chains-in-india#head-1)
- [Conclusion](https://aaft.edu.in/blog/major-hotel-chains-in-india#head-2)

The hospitality industry is one of the fastest-growing industries in India, and hotel management students play a crucial role in its success. Hotel chains in India offer a variety of **[career in hotel management](https://aaft.edu.in/blog/hotel-management-career)**. It is essential to have an understanding of the different hotel chains in India to make informed career choices. This article will discuss the major hotel chains in India that offer a range of services and amenities to meet the diverse needs of travelers.

Whether you’re a persuing [hotel management course](https://aaft.edu.in/programs/ba-hospitality-tourism-management) or planning your career path or an avid traveler looking for the best options for your next trip, this article will provide you with a comprehensive overview of the top hotel chains in India.

## **Major Hotel Chains in India**

### **1\. Taj Hotels**

Taj Hotels is one of the most iconic and luxurious hotel chains in India. It was founded in 1903 and has since grown to become one of the most recognized hotel brands in the country. The chain operates in major cities and tourist destinations across India, offering a blend of traditional Indian hospitality with modern amenities and unparalleled services.

### **2\. The Oberoi Group**

The Oberoi Group is another renowned hotel chain in India known for its luxury and sophistication. Founded in 1934, the group has established itself as a leading player in the hospitality industry, offering guests an unmatched experience with its world-class amenities and personalized service. The group has a presence in six countries, with 33 hotels and resorts in operation. They have a strong presence in the luxury hotel segment and are known for their focus on innovation and technology.

### **3\. ITC Hotels**

ITC Hotels is one of the largest hotel chains in India, with a presence in over 20 cities across the country. The chain offers a range of hotels, from budget to luxury, catering to the diverse needs of travelers. ITC Hotels is known for its focus on sustainability and responsible tourism.

### **4\. Marriott Hotels**

Marriott International is one of the largest hotel chains in the world, and the company has a significant presence in India. The group owns and operates over 120 hotels in India, ranging from luxury properties to budget hotels. Marriott International is known for its commitment to customer service and the quality of its properties.

### **5\. The Leela Palaces**

The Leela Palaces, Hotels, and Resorts is a luxury Indian hotel chain founded in 1986. The group owns and operates nine luxury hotels and resorts in India and has a presence in the United States. The Leela Palaces, Hotels, and Resorts are known for their elegant properties and excellent customer service. They have a focus on sustainability and are committed to minimizing their impact on the environment.

### **6\. Accor Hotels**

AccorHotels chain has a significant presence in India, with more than 50 hotels operating under various brands such as Novotel, Sofitel, Pullman, and Ibis. AccorHotels caters to a broad range of travelers, offering a variety of accommodation options, including resorts, hotels, and serviced apartments.

### **7\. Hyatt Hotels**

Hyatt Hotels is a global hotel chain with a strong presence in India. The chain has hotels located in major cities such as Mumbai, Delhi, and Hyderabad. Hyatt offers a range of brands catering to different segments of travelers, from luxury to mid-scale, including Park Hyatt, Grand Hyatt, Hyatt Regency, and Hyatt Place.

### **8\. Radisson Hotels**

Radisson Hotels is a popular hotel chain in India known for its luxurious properties and world-class amenities. The chain has a presence in major cities and tourist destinations across the country, offering guests an unmatched experience with its personalized service.

### **9\. Lemon Tree Hotels**

Lemon Tree Hotels is a budget hotel chain with a presence in over 30 cities across India. The chain offers comfortable and affordable accommodations for budget-conscious travelers, with modern amenities and personalized service.

## **Conclusion**

India’s hospitality industry has seen immense growth in recent years, with the major hotel chains setting up their properties across the country. From luxurious resorts to budget-friendly hotels, these chains have established themselves as pioneers of hospitality. Students interested in a career in hospitality can gain valuable experience by working with these hotel chains and contribute to the growth of the industry. With the industry’s growth showing no signs of slowing down, India’s hospitality industry is a great place for students to build a rewarding career.
